verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': Ha juntzanh ley tik ol al t'a heb' etchonhab' yik sk'anab'ajej heb':

Tato ay junok winh eyetchonhab' tze mana' yik tz'och he chekab'ok, anhej wake' ab'il smunlaj winh heyet'ok, haxo t'a yukil ab'il tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre, yikxo sb'a winh. Malaj tumin syak' winh yik tzeyak'anel winh t'a libre chi'.
Tato sch'okojilnhej winh k'ochnak t'ayex, hanheja' sch'okojil winh sb'ati. Tato ay ix yetb'eyum winh yet'nak jun, hanheja' syik'b'at ix winh yet'ok.
Tato a ex ix he man winh chi', a ex ix eyak'och yetb'eyum winh, skan ix ix chi' yet' heb' unin heyet'ok, sch'okoj winh sb'ati.
Tato syal winh chekab' chi' jun: Malaj in gana tzin el t'a libre yujto xajan winh in patrón yet' ix wetb'eyum yet' pax heb' wuninal wu'uj, tato xchi winh,

tzeyik'b'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yajal. Tz'och linhan winh t'a smarcoal spuerta'il sdespacho heb' winh yajal chi', tzeyolan schikin winh t'a k'e'en ol-lab', tz'ochkan yechel winh to skan winh heyet'ok t'a junelnhej.
Tato ay junok mach schonhel yisil t'a chekab'ok, max yal-laj yak'jiel heb' ix t'a libre ichok heb' winh winak.

Tato a winh spatrón ix chi' maj cha'anlaj sk'ol yoch ix yetb'eyumok icha yaj strato heb' yujto malaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal smanjixiel ix yuj junok sk'ab'yok. Wach'chom malaj snib'ej winh patrón chi' syik'laj sb'a yet' ix, palta max yal-laj schonhan ix winh t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il.
Tato a winh patrón chi' smanan ix yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok junok yuninal, ichaokab' yisil syutej ix.
Palta tato a winh spatrón ix chi' tz'ik'an ix yetb'eyumok, syik'an junokxo ix winh, mokab' emnakil tz'aj ix b'ab'el chi', palta yowalil syak' swa'el ix winh yet' spichul ix, swaypax winh yet' ix.
Tato max sk'anab'ajej winh yak'an oxe' tastak tik, tz'aktajel ix, manhxa pax tas stup ix yik tz'aktajeli.
Ha mach smilancham junok anima, yowalil smiljipaxchamok.
Palta tato manh sk'anok sk'ol ix milwaji, tato stiempo'alxo scham jun anima chi', a in Jehová in ol wal t'ayex b'aj ol b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a jun mach ix milancham anima chi'.
Palta a mach scham wal sna'ani smilancham yetanima'il, wach'chom b'aj ay waltar sb'at skol sb'a, tz'ik'chajelta, smiljichamok.
Ha mach smak'an smam ma snun, yowalil schami.
Tato ay mach tz'elk'anb'at junok anima, tato toxo ix schonhb'ati, ma aytoek' yet'ok, ayik syamchaj jun elk'um anima chi', yowalil schami.
Ha mach sb'ajan smam snun, mak'jokab' chamok.
Tato ay chawanhok syak' owal, tato ay junok winh slajwi yuj junxo winh chi', taxonhej k'e'en syak'lab'ej winh, ma yet' sk'ab', anhejto max chami, palta te niwan ix aj yab'an sya'il,
haxo t'a jaye'ok k'uhal tzaxo yal yek'xi yet' sk'okoch. Ha winh smak'waj chi', yowalil stup winh b'aj tz'anhtaj winh slajwi chi' yet' pax sk'u winh, palta max ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Tato ay junok winh patrón smak'an schekab' yet' te te', taxonhej winak ma ix, haxo tz'aji schami, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh winh.
Palta tato tzato ek' jun chekab' chi' chab' oxeokxo k'uhal, ichato chi' schami, maxtzak ak'jiochlaj chamel t'a yib'anh winh patrón chi', yujto yik yaj jun schekab' chi'.

Tato ay chawanhok winak wan yak'an owal, syamchajk'och junok ix ix to yab'ixxo t'a skal owal chi' yuj heb', tz'el unin chi' t'a spatik ix, palta malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an ix, a winh tz'och smul chi' stupan jantak sk'an winh yetb'eyum ix, anhejton pax ha', hato syala' tas tz'aj sch'olb'itaj yuj heb' winh juez.
Palta tato ay tas tz'ik'an ix jun, hato syala' tas tz'ik'an ix chi', icha pax chi' tz'utajpax winh tz'och smul chi'. Tato scham ix, schampax winh.
Tato tz'ixtax yol sat ix, ma k'e'en ye ix, ma sk'ab' ix, ma yok ix,
ta stz'a ix, ma slajwi ix, ma tonhej syaxla' sniwanil ix, hanheja' icha wal tz'utaj ix chi', icha wal chi' tz'utajpax winh winak chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anpoj yol sat junok winh schekab', ma junok ix schekab', tz'aktajel winh chekab' ma ix chekab' sk'exulok jun yol sat ix poj chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smak'anel k'e'en ye junok schekab', tz'aktajel jun chekab' chi' sk'exulok k'e'en ye chi'.
Tato ay junok nok' toro stekancham junok anima, yowalil sjuljicham nok', max chijilaj schib'ejal nok', palta malaj tas tz'och t'a yib'anh winh yajal nok' chi'.
Palta tato yojtak winh yajal nok' chi' to owtaxon nok' t'a anima, max yetzb'anpax nok' winh, tato stekjicham junok anima yuj nok', yowalil sjuljicham nok', schampax winh yajal nok' chi'.
Tato schaji tupchaj jun chamel chi', stup winh yajal nok' chi', hato syala' jantak sk'an heb' aj chamnak chi', tato icha chi' maxtzak chamlaj winh.
Haton wal juntzanh ley tik tz'och yopisio tato ay junok uninab'il ma isilab'il stekjicham yuj nok' wakax.
Tato a junok winh chekab', ma junok ix chekab' stekjicham yuj nok', yowalil tz'ak'chaj 30 siclo k'e'en plata t'a winh spatrón jun chekab' chi', sjuljipaxcham nok' wakax chi'.
K'inalok ay junok mach max smakchej sti' ha' yuk'lab' ha', ma sjoy junok olan, max smakchejpax sti', sb'at junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' b'uru t'a yo'ol,
yowalil stup winh ay yik jun olan chi' t'a winh aj nok' chi', skan nok' ix cham chi' t'a winh ay yik olan chi'.

Tato ay junok nok' storo junok mach stekancham nok' storo junokxo, yowalil schonhjiel nok' ix tekwaj chi', spukanek' k'e'en stojol nok' chi' heb' t'a spatik. Hanheja' spukpaxek' nok' ix tekjicham chi' heb'.
Tato yojtakxo winh ay yik nok' ix tekwaj chi' to toxonton ow nok', max stanhwanpax nok' winh, yowalil syak' junokxo nok' winh sk'exulok nok' ix cham chi', skan nok' chamnak chi' t'a winh.
